company.name: TAQA
company.shortDescription: TAQA provides energy and water to communities around the world.
company.description: TAQA is a utilities and energy company that engages in power, water, and oil and gas operations. It is an international company listed in Abu Dhabi and operates in 11 countries across four continents.

productsAndServices.description: TAQA operates power generation facilities with a total capacity of 23 GW, including renewable energy sources contributing 1.4 GW.

productsAndServices.description: TAQA manages water distribution networks, including 21 kilometers of pipelines, meeting 95% of Abu Dhabi's water needs.

productsAndServices.description: TAQA oversees electricity transmission and distribution networks, covering 90 kilometers, ensuring reliable power supply.

productsAndServices.description: TAQA is involved in renewable energy projects, aiming for renewables to account for 65% of its power generation capacity by 2030.
